name: Free Dictionary API
rate_limits: No documented rate limits. Completely free with no API key required.
notes: Fully free dictionary API with no auth. Returns rich JSON with definitions, phonetics, audio URLs, parts of speech, examples, synonyms, and antonyms. Useful for AI/NLP applications: building vocabulary datasets, word sense disambiguation training data, pronunciation features, and language understanding augmentation. Supports English language lookups. Simple REST interface: GET /api/v2/entries/en/{word}.
